item.title: python3Packages.openusd: 26.05 -> 26.11.1
item.description:
Part of #583070.

Bumps OpenUSD 26.05 -> 26.11.1, which fixes:

  • CVE-2026-92211 / GHSA-75r4-2rhh-hrxw: race / double free in CrateFile::_ReadPathsImpl when parsing .usdc/.usdz files with crate version < 0.4.0
  • GHSA-qgc5-vc49-x7jw, GHSA-5hf7-7jmm-gqcf: command injection in usdview / usdedit

Changelog: https://github.com/PixarAnimationStudios/OpenUSD/blob/v26.11.1/CHANGELOG.md

Notable changes:

  • Behaviour change: binary crate files (.usd/.usdc) older than version 0.4.0 are now rejected at read time (upstream security fix; usdupdatecrate can upgrade such files).
  • Upstream moved to the VFX Reference Platform 2025 dependency baseline (oneTBB, OpenImageIO 3, newer OCIO/OpenEXR/Alembic/Qt); nixpkgs already satisfies these.
  • Enable PXR_BUILD_OPENIMAGEIO_PLUGIN: it provides OpenImageIO-based texture loading for Hydra, and since 26.11 it is also required for OSL support (sdrOsl links OpenImageIO::OpenImageIO, which upstream only resolves when the OIIO plugin is enabled). OpenImageIO was already an unconditional build input.
  • Upstream now installs the Python bindings into lib/pythonX.Y/site-packages by default, so PXR_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR is set explicitly and the postInstall move is dropped.

Not backportable as-is: release-26.05 is still on 25.05.01, so the stable fix is a separate PR with a targeted patch

Testing (x86_64-linux):

  • python3Packages.openusd and openusd (with withTools/withUsdView) build; pythonImportsCheck passes.
  • Opened Pixar's Kitchen_set sample (mixed .usda/crate 0.8.0): loads fully via Python (2742 prims), opens in usdview, and renders correctly with usdrecord.
  • A crate file with its version bytes changed to 0.3.0 is rejected with "Cannot read asset ... with obsolete version".

This PR (code, commit message and description) was prepared with the help of Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5); I reviewed the changes and verified the results above.

item.description:
https://github.com/php/frankenphp/releases/tag/v1.13.5

1.13.5 is a security release fixing 17 advisories (1 high, 11 medium, 5 low). It also upgrades the bundled Caddy to 2.11.9 (security fixes in Caddy itself) and Mercure to 1.1.6.

  • Fixes GHSA-j99q-3wr8-xj43 (high, php_server: a non-PHP file such as /uploads/photos.php.php/avatar.jpg could be run as PHP)
  • Fixes GHSA-jvmv-5538-pqpg
  • Fixes GHSA-2725-rh2w-9j9w
  • Fixes GHSA-j45x-h238-h4xx
  • Fixes GHSA-5359-vg53-5464

  • Fixes GHSA-2x4j-r638-wxff
  • Fixes GHSA-388m-835f-7723
  • Fixes GHSA-g7pw-whv8-97j7
  • Fixes GHSA-v7hf-4gqv-hf8p
  • Fixes GHSA-8qcf-v46r-g2mc
  • Fixes GHSA-j2f3-wxf2-8qgv
  • Fixes GHSA-xh92-4p94-ch7x

  • Fixes GHSA-g9v4-rp77-rv76
  • Fixes GHSA-cp2q-fc46-38f5
  • Fixes GHSA-28vm-87fh-3px5

Upstream flags one small breaking change in worker mode: between requests, only state built from the HTTP request is reset now. error_get_last(), libxml errors, strtok() and http_get_last_response_headers() persist across requests again, the same way userland state does.

The package change is only the version and hash bump. Go 1.27.3 (needed by caddy/go.mod) is already in nixpkgs.

Tested on x86_64-linux: frankenphp version reports FrankenPHP 1.13.5 PHP 8.5.12 Caddy v2.11.9, frankenphp php-server serves a PHP page (with the new $_SERVER['SERVER_ADDR'] populated), and passthru.tests.phpinfo builds.

item.title: botan3: 3.13.0 -> 3.14.0
item.description:
Disclosure: the bug fixes for this botan bump were created with AI (Claude Opus 5.5).

Things done

I reviewed the botan bump by the auto update bot (#583447) and looked at the build/test failures. The all come from changed default behavior or harder checks in Botan 3.14.0, see: https://botan.randombit.net/news.html#version-3-14-0-2026-11-04

Most notably, ECDSA now uses randomized signature by default (probably because they are more secure in the eye of e.g. BSI or NIST). This leads to test suite failures for KeepassXC and ChiPass (KeepassXC fork). Haskell's botan-low also fails on related issues (tests try to use DSA parameters no longer allowed). I fixed and reviewed this with AI.

The KeepassXC issue is tracked in: https://github.com/keepassxreboot/keepassxc/issues/14017 The ChiPass issue is tracked in: https://codeberg.org/ChiPass/ChiPass/issues/260 The botan-low issues is tracked in: https://github.com/haskell-cryptography/botan/issues/145
